Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and context. We can support a scoped custodial preservation for acct-SY-7721; I wanted to confirm a couple of details so we scope the deliverables correctly: 

1) Scope: when you say "session and inference logs," do you want:
   - raw inference traces (per-request payloads and responses),
   - operational debug traces (service-side debug spans), and/or
   - ephemeral session metadata (session IDs, timestamps) only?

2) Keystore: please confirm the customer key alias/ID you want us to pull (if you don't have it, we can search by tenant mapping but that adds time).

3) Delivery: we typically provide keystore rotation logs as CSV (signed hash manifest) and logs as gzipped NDJSON. Do you have a preference or a secure transfer method we should use?

4) Retention window: you asked for 120d for keystore logs; confirm that end date is 2026-11-02 (i.e., last 120d up to today).

I will loop in our Security Evidence team and Legal to prepare the custodial-hold statement and a delivery plan. For now, we will mark acct-SY-7721 as "forensics preserve" in our ticketing system pending your confirmation on the items above.

If you need an immediate written acknowledgement for your auditors, here's an interim statement we can sign: "Redwood Inference confirms that it has initiated a scoped custodial preservation for tenant acct-SY-7721 effective 2026-11-02, pending final scope confirmation." Let me know if that works and I'll send a signed PDF.

Best,
